edges.reason: Constructor writes the token name state variable.
Constructor writes the token symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the total supply.
Constructor credits the full supply to msg.sender in the balances mapping.
msg.sender determines the initial mint recipient during construction.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller identity controls the account debited.
transferFrom spends the allowance of msg.sender without validating the caller's spend right beyond the mapping value.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances at address(0).
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
The unchecked subtraction consumes and effectively reduces the reported _totalSupply value.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
balanceOf indexes balances with the tokenOwner parameter.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
allowance indexes allowed with the tokenOwner parameter.
allowance indexes allowed with the spender parameter.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approve consumes the spender parameter as the allowance key.
approve consumes the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
transfer writes and reads the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer delegates the sender debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates the recipient credit to safeAdd.
transfer uses the to parameter as the credit destination.
transfer uses the tokens parameter as the transferred amount.
transferFrom reads and writes balances of from and to.
transferFrom mutates allowed[from][msg.sender] without checking the allowance covers tokens.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance debits to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates the recipient credit to safeAdd.
transferFrom performs the unverified allowance debit operation.
The unverified allowance debit writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses the from parameter as the debited account.
transferFrom uses the to parameter as the credit destination.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter as the moved amount.
safeAdd reads the first operand parameter a.
safeAdd reads the second operand parameter b.
safeAdd writes the local result c.
safeAdd executes the guarded integer addition.
The addition result is assigned to the local c.
safeSub reads the minuend parameter a.
safeSub reads the subtrahend parameter b.
safeSub writes the local result c.
safeSub executes the guarded integer subtraction.
The subtraction result is assigned to the local c.
safeMul reads the first operand parameter a.
safeMul reads the second operand parameter b.
safeMul writes the local result c.
safeMul executes the guarded integer multiplication.
The multiplication result is assigned to the local c.
safeDiv reads the numerator parameter a.
safeDiv reads the denominator parameter b.
safeDiv writes the local result c.
safeDiv executes the guarded integer division.
The division result is assigned to the local c.
